Step Number: 11

Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in understanding the task requirements. The problem was to determine which director was born earlier, not which director was older at the time of the film's release. The Planner incorrectly concluded that José Luis Garci was born earlier because he was older when his film was released, rather than comparing the actual birth years of the directors, which clearly indicate Eduardo Morera (born 1906) was born earlier than José Luis Garci (born 1944).
